groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.610% and the 10Y at 4.952%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is +1.54% over five sessions and -2.34% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +2.37% at about $117.60, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-38/100, 76% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is limited positive confirmation on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is -3.20% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -38/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -30 → now -38; open -41 → now -38 (improved 3 points).

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are a headwind: Live · SOX -7.46% | Nasdaq -2.64% | SOX vs Nasdaq -4.82 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq -5.84 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq -4.32 pp. Mega-caps are mixed: Live · 7-stock basket -1.47% | 0/7 positive | QQQ -3.20% | relative +1.73 pp. Fed pricing is a headwind: Dec 9: Hike 80% / Hold 20% / Cut 0% · Jan 27: Above current 86% / Same 14% / Below 0% · Mar 17: Above current 95% / Same 6% / Below 0%.
